==Purpose of template==
Select a (possibly random) quote.

==How to use==

<pre>
{{Sandbox/androlf/WotQ}}
{{Sandbox/androlf/WotQ|tags}}
{{Sandbox/androlf/WotQ|{{PAGENAME}}}}
</pre>

==Examples==

{| class="wikitable"
| Description
| Code
| Result
|-
| Random quote
| <pre>{{Sandbox/androlf/WotQ}}</pre>
|         {{Sandbox/androlf/WotQ}}
|-
| Random quote related to a named character
| <pre>{{Sandbox/androlf/WotQ|Mat}}</pre>
|         {{Sandbox/androlf/WotQ|Mat}}
|-
| Random quote related to a named character using an alias
| <pre>{{Sandbox/androlf/WotQ|Nyn}}</pre>
|         {{Sandbox/androlf/WotQ|Nyn}}
|-
| Random quote ''not'' related to named character
| <pre>{{Sandbox/androlf/WotQ|all
!Rand}}</pre>
|         {{Sandbox/androlf/WotQ|all
!Rand}}
|-
| Random quote related to a named character ''not'' related to another named character
| <pre>{{Sandbox/androlf/WotQ|Mat
Rand}}</pre>
|         {{Sandbox/androlf/WotQ|Mat
Rand}}
|-
|}
